title: Temporal proximity between map input and route records is not travel proof
action: local map input occurs near a route update for an unproven ship entity

sensitivityHandling.notes: Route and entity values are synthetic and deliberately leave ownership/local attribution unproven.

expectedNonEvents.reason: Map-open timing plus a route object is not a direct destination-set source.
Nearby route updates for an unknown entity must not mutate local destination state.
The route record does not prove the local player started travel.
The route record does not prove terminal arrival.
Map close is not a travel cancellation signal.
Unknown route phase is not failure evidence.

correlation.notes: Temporal adjacency and repeated destination text are intentionally preserved while local attribution remains unproven.

knownLimitations: This synthetic edge case does not prove exact Star Citizen input log spelling.
It exists to lock the product boundary that timing and route proximity are insufficient without direct semantic evidence.
verificationNotes: Unhappy-path parser tests should assert no destination or travel lifecycle event is emitted from temporal proximity alone.
